meta.readMe: The pool is the top DPS rankings for one spec, which biases it toward fast kills: a mechanic that only appears late may be under-represented or absent, and 'journalOnly' lists catalogued abilities the pool never cast. Times are given both from the pull start (atSeconds) and from the start of the phase segment they landed in (atSegmentSeconds); the second is the stable one. A segment index is not a phase number -- phases repeat, so read phaseId/cycle.

journal.title: Dig In
journal.description: Sszorak hunkers down during Howling Maelstrom, increasing his damage taken by 30% for 25 sec.

journal.title: Mutilate
journal.description:
Sszorak rakes his venom-coated claws in a frontal cone, inflicting 4792088 Nature damage split evenly among players struck and afflicting them with Mutilated Gash.

If Mutilate strikes 5 or fewer players, it inflicts deadly damage.

journal.title: Raging Crosswinds
journal.description:
The Altar of the Six Winds imbues several players with roiling winds, inflicting 20835 Nature damage every 1 sec for 8 sec.

Upon expiration, the winds inflict 500044 Nature damage to players within 6 yards. The winds then knock each affected player in the indicated direction and apply Turbulent Gusts.

journal.title: Ravage
journal.description: Sszorak slashes repeatedly, inflicting 3500308 Physical damage to all players in a frontal cone and increasing their damage taken from Ravage by 600% for 25 sec. This effect stacks.

journal.title: Tempest
journal.description: Sszorak forms vortices of poisonous wind which spiral around the arena. These inflict 500044 Nature damage plus an additional 208352 Nature damage every 1 sec and reduce movement speed by 30% for 6 sec. This effect stacks.

journal.title: Venomous Surge
journal.description:
Sszorak heaves fresh venom onto several players, inflicting 100009 Nature damage every 1 sec for 10 sec.

Upon expiration, the venom detonates forming a Viscous Cyst and inflicting 500044 Nature damage to all players, decreasing in damage as distance increases.
